run_test_file_chunker: run the unittest TestFileChunker suite to verify find_offsets and Chunker work correctly
test_find_offsets: test the find_offsets function by splitting a file into N equal byte-sized chunks
test_chunker_read: test the Chunker context manager to read lines from a byte range of a file
test_readchunks: test reading chunked lines from offsets returned by find_offsets for a given file
review_test_file_chunker: review the TestFileChunker unittest class and its test_find_offsets and test_readchunks methods
